questions.q: The candela is the SI base unit of which quantity?
questions.explain: Candela (cd) is one of the seven SI base units — it measures luminous intensity.
questions.voice_q: Here's your first one. The candela is the S I base unit of which quantity? Five seconds... think fast!
questions.voice_a: Yes! It's B — luminous intensity. The candela is one of the seven S I base units. Nailed it!

questions.prompt: Match each physical quantity to its correct SI unit
questions.explain: Force → Newton, Pressure → Pascal, Energy → Joule, Power → Watt.
questions.voice_q: Now match them up! Each physical quantity to its correct S I unit. Force, pressure, energy, power. Go!
questions.voice_a: Beautifully done! Force to Newton. Pressure to Pascal. Energy to Joule. And power to Watt. Perfect match!
